summary: Bilibili Inc. filed a Form 6-K on June 17, 2026 reporting the results of its annual general meeting (AGM) held that same day. The filing includes a press release announcing the AGM poll results and the adoption of a Ninth Amended and Restated Memorandum and Articles of Association via special resolution. No terms such as price, stake, premium, or tender were disclosed. The board did not make any recommendation regarding a special situation. This is a routine governance update; no special-situations event such as an acquisition, going-private, or restructuring is present.
